name: Cutter
description: A dangerous & intimidating fighter. XP trigger: You addressed a challenge with violence or coercion.

features.name: Battleborn
features.description: You may expend your special armor to reduce harm from an attack in combat or to push yourself during a fight.

features.name: Bodyguard
features.description: When you protect a teammate, take +1d to your resistance roll. When you gather info to anticipate possible threats in the current situation, you get +1 effect.

features.name: Ghost Fighter
features.description: You may imbue your hands, melee weapons, or tools with spirit energy. You gain potency in combat vs. the supernatural. You may grapple with spirits to restrain and capture them.

features.name: Leader
features.description: When you Command a cohort in combat, they continue to fight when they would otherwise break (they're not taken out when they suffer level 3 harm). They gain +1 effect and 1 armor.

features.name: Mule
features.description: Your load limits are higher. Light: 5. Normal: 7. Heavy: 8.

features.name: Not to Be Trifled With
features.description: You can push yourself to do one of the following: perform a feat of physical force that verges on the superhuman -- engage a small gang on equal footing in close combat.

features.name: Savage
features.description: When you unleash physical violence, it's especially frightening. When you Command a frightened target, take +1d.

features.name: Vigorous
features.description: You recover from harm faster. Permanently fill in one of your healing clock segments. Take +1d to healing treatment rolls.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
